note: Internal. What changed or broke tonight, for the weekly review. Script only.

types.NEW_SET: A TCGCSV set (group) appeared that was not there last night, or a future product in a news calendar is not on the radar.
types.NEW_RELEASE: A product appeared on the release radar or releases file.
types.RELEASE_DATE_CHANGE: A radar date changed since last night, or a news calendar shows another date for a radar product.
types.PRICE_MOVE: A single or sealed product moved 50%+ and $10+ between the last two price days (both prices $5+).
types.NEWS_SOURCE_FAILING: A news source failed or returned nothing tonight.
types.NEWS_LEAD: A news headline matched a research category: supply, grading, new product or market news.
types.DATA_GAP: A calendar day has no TCGCSV price file, or tonight's file priced 10%+ fewer products than the last one.
types.STALE_FILE: A file the reads depend on is older than its allowed age.
types.ODD_PRICE: Prices held back as likely data errors (Card Rating held list, sealed price outliers).
types.READ_TYPE_EMPTY: A known read type produced nothing tonight.
